name: Moisturising Body Lotion (200ml)
subtitle: Developed by dermatologists for the softest skin EVER

benefits.title: Super soft
benefits.description: Enriched with natural, moisturising ingredients, this lotion does away with dry skin. Nourish your kid's delicate skin with moisture that lasts round the clock.

benefits.title: Non-greasy
benefits.description: Use this on your child without the worry of feeling sticky, slippery or greasy.

benefits.title: Convenience
benefits.description: This pump bottle makes it easy to dispense and apply without the worry of cleaning the bottle!

benefits.title: 100% Safe
benefits.description: We are obsessed with what goes on our kids' sensitive skin. We formulated and dermatologically tested this lotion without ANY harmful components.

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Soothing and nourishing, aloe vera is a super ingredient for growing hair and skin. It has anti-bacterial and anti-oxidant properties and it thoroughly moisturises your little one's skin.

ingredients.name: Calendula Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: With extreme soothing properties, this is the perfect herbal ingredient for your child.

ingredients.name: Oat Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Oat is not just made for eating! It's also excellent on the skin and scalp. It has soothing properties which invoke a gentle after-bath feeling.

ingredients.name: Neem
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Neem is an ancient herbal remedy to fighting germs while being gentle on the skin.

ingredients.name: Chickpea Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Don't you love the feeling of your little one's soft skin? Chickpea is a gentle ingredient that helps keep that softness in kids' skin!

ingredients.name: Milk Protein Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Milk protein is a brilliant moisturiser for kids' skin. It has extreme hydrating properties and solves for dry skin by penetrating the skin barrier and moisturising from within.

fullIngredientsList: Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Emulsifying Wax, Cocoa Butter, Shea Butter, Cetostearyl Alcohol, Glycerine, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Calendula Officinalis Extract, Citric Acid, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Olea Europaea Fruit Oil, Perfume, Sodium Benzoate (And) Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Lactate, Stearic Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate, Cetearyl Olivate (And) Sorbitan Olivate, Sodium Hydroxide, Sodium Gluconate.

description:
Want to keep your child's skin feeling cotton-smooth?

Our moisturising lotion is enriched with aloe vera and extract for soothing, nourishing and hydrating dry skin.

This non-greasy formula is made safe certified and 100% free of harmful chemicals.

1. Take 2-3 pumps of the lotion and warm it up in your hands
2. Gently massage onto skin after a bath until absorbed
3. Use twice a day for best results!

howToUse:
Take some lotion on your hands & gently massage

"This lotion is perfect for Trisha! She puts a little in her palms and rubs it on her arms and it works great for dry skin. It also has a lovely smell. My daughter loves how smoothly the lotion applies and I love that it’s got natural ingredients!"

faqs.question: Is Little Joys Lotion safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, they’re free from added parabens, dyes, sulphates, and phthalates making it completely safe to be used on a child's delicate skin.

faqs.question: When should I apply the lotion?
faqs.answer: You can apply the lotion at any time of the day. However, post bath is ideal.

faqs.question: Can adults use this lotion as well?
faqs.answer: Yes, adults can use the lotion too.

reviews.author: Shivani Jose
reviews.title: Good quality lotion
reviews.body: Fantastic lotion, this lotion is very much good for the new born babies... u can feel the soft skin of the baby after applying it ... Peppa Pig character looks great on it as well... I advise for all the Mom to buy it.

reviews.author: Praneesh Verma
reviews.title: My kid loves it
reviews.body: A very effective product designed especially for baby's soft skin. Provides long lasting moisturization that leaves baby's skin hydrated for long hours. U don't even need to apply it in big quantities, a little bit is enough for moisturizing your baby's skin. Very good packaging and m my daughter loves it when I apply because it has her favourite Peppa Pig character on it. Highly convenient to carry as well as apply. Worth every penny.

reviews.author: Sejal Shah
reviews.title: Highly recommended for dry skin
reviews.body: I just love this lotion. It’s so soft on the skin, hydrates and keeps it moisturised. I also realised that it keeps the skin moisturised for long hours. It’s very easy to apply and runs smoothly on the skin.
